product_metadata.title: Deconovo Decorative Sheer Curtains 54 Inch Length, Rod Pocket Voile Curtain, Voile Drapes for Kitchen (38x54 Inch, Beige, 2 Panels)
features: BASIC INFORMATION: Two Panels Per Package, Each panel measures 38W x 54L Inch.

HANGING STYLES: This Deconovo sheer curtains can be styled in 2 ways: rod pocket or with your own clip-rings. The length of the pocket is about 2.75 inches, as most of the family curtain rods can fit in.

LIGHT FILTERING: This Deconovo sheer voile curtains allow plenty of natural light to flow through the room. They are perfect for kitchen, nursery, living room, bedroom, sliding door, patio door and so on.
SEMI SHEER: Our see-through voile sheer drapes enable you to appreciate the beautiful scene outside the window freely while sustaining a bit of decent space.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Please hand wash or dry clean. Iron at low temperature settings. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry.
